scenario.topic: Decide which acoustic treatment to install in a small music studio

options.name: Foam Panel Absorbers
options.upside: Improves mid to high frequency absorption effectively.
options.concern: Less effective at controlling low-frequency sound reflections.

options.name: Bass Traps and Acoustic Panels Combo
options.upside: Balances absorption across low and high frequencies.
options.concern: Requires more installation space, reducing usable room area.

options.name: Fabric-Wrapped Fiberglass Panels
options.upside: Provides effective sound absorption with aesthetic customization.
options.concern: Panels can be fragile and require careful handling during installation.

options.name: Diffuser and Absorber Hybrid Panels
options.upside: Reduces echo while preserving natural room ambiance.
options.concern: Less absorption power compared to pure absorbers, especially in bass frequencies.

shared_context: A small music studio requires acoustic treatment to improve sound quality and reduce echo. The treatment must fit within a 100 sq ft room and accommodate two people working simultaneously.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a sound engineer with a passion for studio aesthetics and balanced acoustic performance.
personas.private_goal: To select an acoustic treatment that combines effective absorption with visual appeal for a small studio.

A.reason_for: Moderate cost and effective mid to high frequency absorption.
A.reason_against: Less effective at controlling low-frequency sound reflections, which is important for balanced sound.

B.reason_for: Balances absorption across low and high frequencies, improving overall sound quality.
B.reason_against: Higher cost and requires more installation space, which could reduce usable room area.

C.reason_for: Provides effective sound absorption with aesthetic customization, fitting well in a small studio.

D.reason_for: Reduces echo while preserving natural room ambiance, adding character to the space.
D.reason_against: Less absorption power compared to pure absorbers, especially in bass frequencies.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a music producer focused on practical and cost-effective solutions for small studio setups.
personas.private_goal: To choose an acoustic treatment that maximizes sound quality without compromising room usability or budget.

C.reason_for: Moderate cost and effective absorption with aesthetic benefits.
C.reason_against: Fragile panels require careful installation, which could complicate setup.

D.reason_for: Preserves natural room ambiance and reduces echo.
D.reason_against: Less absorption power, especially in bass frequencies, which may impact sound clarity.
